summary: Square's PlayStation scrolling shooter, later reissued on the Japanese PlayStation Network.

entries.title: Einhander

emulation.notes: Use internal resolution scaling and PGXP/geometry correction only if they do not introduce visual issues.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation assets with high-quality PS1 emulation and modern capture.

primary.why: Einhander has no sourced modern remaster; the original PlayStation release is the complete version, and high-quality PS1 emulation is the best fidelity/capture route for an owned copy.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation disc or image through DuckStation with internal resolution scaling. The Japanese PlayStation Network release is an older official digital route where accessible.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete source release and best archival route when paired with high-quality PS1 emulation.
skip: official digital route, but region-limited and not a modern enhanced remaster.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate version with exclusive game content.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or remake.
